backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only close-of-day OHLCV available on the signal date; paper entry is next available open with production entry slippage; exit is the close ten trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.

gate2.note: The sleeve uses only same-day and trailing OHLCV fields plus next-open/exit prices available to replay. It does not ask LLM or production to infer hidden fields.
runtime_fields: SPY OHLCV rows for same-window relative strength

gate3.note: No new core filter or core entry rule was added. The target source is evaluated as additive default-off paper, so core survival is unchanged from the baseline replay.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: entry / candidate_pool: sector-leadership relative-strength trend-continuation may surface a production-visible free-OHLCV candidate source.

2_history_check.exp-20260426-049: Observed-only sector-leadership shadow audit; no current three-window next-open fixed-notional before/after EV replay.
2_history_check.exp-20260525-011/901: Opening-range paper sleeve variants were tested recently; this uses cross-sectional sector leadership instead of same-stock opening-range/macro confirmation.
2_history_check.recent_candidate_pools: Space, AI optical/compute, consumer platform, and broad-market feed pools are recent anti-repeat families; this stays within the existing core universe and uses sector state, not theme membership.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Same three docs/backtesting.md windows; positive aggregate EV/PnL; 3/3 EV-improved windows; no PnL-regressed window; >=20 paper trades across all 3 windows; drawdown drift <=0.5pp; survival >=5%; concentration inside guardrails.

hypothesis: A production-visible sector-leadership relative-strength trend source may add candidate-pool alpha. It should prefer stocks in the top three 20-day sector-median leaders that also beat both their sector median and SPY, without adding arbitrary noisy tickers.
interpretation: The sector-leadership top-1 paper sleeve did not clear Gate 4. Do not promote or retry nearby sector-leadership filters without a new production-visible discriminator or broader forward sample.
next_evidence_needed: If revisited, use a materially new discriminator such as event/source confirmation, sector-breadth persistence, or forward paper rows; do not just retune the same sector-rank/return thresholds on this frozen sample.

production_impact.promotion_requirement: A retained result would still require a shared default-off paper adapter and parity tests before any daily report or live/default behavior changes.

why_not_other_changes: Skipped LLM soft-ranking and expectation-residual because current coverage remains sparse; skipped AI/compute/consumer/Space fixed membership retreads and broad-market feed gates due fresh anti-repeat evidence. This uses a different free-OHLCV cross-sectional sector leadership source.
